title: A flower that cost more than a house

scenes.say: You could swap one tulip for a whole house. But only for one crazy winter, and the ending is brutal.
In sixteen thirty seven, rich Dutch people went mad for striped tulips. So one bulb hit ten thousand guilders. That's a fancy canal house!
Rembrandt got way less for his most famous painting. Sixteen hundred! A flower beat the Night Watch.
You see, nobody was buying flowers. They traded promises in pubs, and flipped them again and again. Would you have bought one?
